mentions.name: Recoup
mentions.description: A web app for ITAD (IT Asset Disposition) companies to record the assets they pick up and notify vendors so the vendors can bid on the items. Using the eBay API, it connects to eBay and lists items for sale online when vendors don't want to buy small lots like a couple of laptops. It is still in development, with demos available on request.
mentions.problem: ITAD companies need an easy way to record the assets they pick up, notify vendors for bids, and sell items that vendors decline to buy, such as a couple of laptops.
mentions.audience: ITAD (IT Asset Disposition) companies that record collected assets and sell them to vendors or online
mentions.source_excerpt: Recoup - a web app designed for ITAD (IT Asset Disposition) companies who want to easily record the assets they're picking up and then notify vendors so the vendors can bid on items.  In addition, using the eBay API, it can connect to eBay and list items for you for sale -- sometimes vendors don't want to buy just a couple of laptops but you can easily sell them online.
